evals.name: compute_indicators_returns_complete_suite
evals.description: When called with default settings, compute_indicators returns MACD / KDJ / BOLL / ATR / RSI / OBV / CCI aligned with the input bar series.

evals.name: compute_macd_rejects_invalid_periods
evals.description: compute_macd rejects fastPeriod >= slowPeriod and period < 1.

evals.name: compute_kdj_invariant_j_equals_3k_minus_2d
evals.description: After the warmup period, KDJ J value equals 3 * K - 2 * D within rounding tolerance.

evals.name: compute_boll_upper_gt_lower
evals.description: Upper band is strictly greater than middle band and middle band is strictly greater than lower band.

evals.name: detect_macross_v_shape
evals.description: Given a V-shaped bar series, detectMACross emits a golden-cross event after the recovery.

evals.name: recognize_patterns_bullish_engulfing
evals.description: Given a bearish then bullish bar with body that fully engulfs the previous bar, recognizePatterns emits a bullish-engulfing pattern.

evals.name: summarize_trend_strictly_rising
evals.description: Given 80 strictly rising bars, summarizeTrend reports direction = uptrend with positive strength.

evals.name: tool_honors_abort_signal
evals.description: Every pi-technical tool returns isError: true when the abort signal is already aborted.

evals.name: tool_emits_audit_id
evals.description: Every pi-technical tool result includes details.auditId matching the input toolCallId.
